race.description: Mitch And George Moruya Trainer Of The Yr Mdn Plate
race.comment: YAMASHITA (11) handy filly with her hoof on the till third up. Drops in grade and trip after savaging the line with a narrow third over 1200m at Kembla Grange. That form is good enough for her to take this out from the rails draw. BRUTAL ADVANCE (2) twelve-start maiden with a tidy record, resuming. Should present well following a recent trial win but might find this short of his best. Place preferred. CHEEKY SORT (4)  drifted back on resumption and failed to get into the contest when sixth over 1100m at Wyong. Awkward gate today and deserves another chance in this weaker contest. EMPTY POCKETS (8) returned for her second campaign with a tiring on-pace fourth over 1020m at this track. Sticky gate again and place preferred.
race.rail_position: Out 3m from 1000m to 380m then cut away rail..
